public_status: Actionable now: vLLM supports draft_model + parallel_drafting with amd/PARD-Qwen3-0.6B.
local_qwen235b_evidence: NeMo-RL Full-GRPO public PARD K3 is now positive in the clean non-colocated TP4 branch: fixed256 step2-5 gives 1.421x total-step and 1.887x generation-time speedup; fixed1024 step2-3 gives 1.580x total-step and 1.797x generation-time speedup under vLLM 0.20.0.
decision: Keep as the validated runtime substrate and public Qwen3-235B baseline; next evidence gate is longer/decode-heavy output, not another fixed256 rerun.

decision: Continue local PARD-2-style objective work, but label it as an approximation.

public_status: Open-source training framework and draft-model bundle direction; paper explicitly targets scalable EAGLE-3 training including Qwen3-235B-A22B.
local_qwen235b_evidence: Useful as a training-infra reference, but current local Qwen3-235B benefit work is PARD/PARD-2-style in vLLM/NeMo-RL, not SGLang EAGLE-3.
decision: Track as the strongest EAGLE-3 retraining reference if PARD-style Full-GRPO E2E remains weak.

implementation_source: No local drop-in implementation; the deployed NeMo-RL runtime batch gate is a static systems approximation.
public_status: Public arXiv method for load-aware adaptive speculative length and disabling speculation when load makes it unprofitable.
local_qwen235b_evidence: Directly matches the Qwen3-235B high-batch question. Runtime gate smoke 3212586 proved the patched vLLM scheduler can disable speculation at requests=32 with request_threshold=16; performance-valid retry is 3212702.
decision: Keep as the systems-policy direction for dynamic K/load-aware gating. Do not claim Nightjar itself is implemented; we currently have only static request/token gating.

public_status: Public 2025 batch speculative-decoding method that selects promising draft tokens across requests instead of assigning the same fixed draft depth to every request.
local_qwen235b_evidence: Direct fit for GBS512: Qwen3-235B batches have heterogeneous acceptance, and fixed K can waste verifier capacity on low-probability later draft positions.
decision: Use as the conceptual target for an offline simulator over logged PARD draft/acceptance traces before changing vLLM token packing.

implementation_source: Paper reports a vLLM prototype, but no local drop-in implementation is present.
public_status: Public 2026 serving-system method with per-request speculative length, early pruning during verification, and draft/verify overlap.
local_qwen235b_evidence: Strong systems fit for high-batch Qwen3-235B if static K5 helps generation but E2E is still limited by wasted verification/draft serialization.
decision: Track as the deeper systems target after the current static gate and simple dynamic-K controller; do not claim implemented.

public_status: Training-free online bandit controller for speculative-decoding hyperparameters.
local_qwen235b_evidence: Practical controller layer for choosing among K values once K3/K5/K8 standalone and NeMo-RL evidence is complete.
decision: Start with a simpler bucketed controller: reward = accepted tokens/sec minus draft/verify waste, segmented by active batch and prompt/domain bucket.

public_status: Public 2026 method that overlaps drafting with verification by preparing likely next speculations before the verifier returns.
local_qwen235b_evidence: Relevant only if profiling shows draft latency is still exposed after dynamic-K; it is more invasive than request-level K control.
decision: Later systems branch; not a near-term Qwen3-235B NeMo-RL patch.

public_status: Training-free 2026 method aimed at reducing false rejections by using online correction memory and probability-guarded acceptance.
local_qwen235b_evidence: Relevant to the user's domain-mismatch/PARD-2 question: if PARD acceptance drops because the draft is lexically different but semantically close, CSD-style rescue could raise effective acceptance without retraining. No Qwen3-235B local implementation yet.
decision: Track as an acceptance-rescue research branch. It requires careful distribution-correctness review before NeMo-RL use, so it is behind PARD/PARD-2 and runtime gating.

public_status: Serving-system method for overlapping draft generation and target verification; public path is SGLang-side, not a NeMo-RL drop-in.
local_qwen235b_evidence: Relevant to our Qwen3-235B failure mode if generation speedup exists but Full-GRPO E2E loses to orchestration/verification cost.
decision: Systems follow-up after no-stop Full-GRPO metrics identify whether verify/draft overlap is the actual bottleneck.

public_status: Benchmark/profiling work focused on when speculative decoding speedup is real versus illusory.
local_qwen235b_evidence: Matches our Qwen3-235B observation: high acceptance K1 and long-context cases can still be slower due draft/verify/system cost.
decision: Use as diagnostic framing; keep acceptance, accepted length, draft cost, verify cost, and E2E step time in the same report.
